questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how tickets are converted to and from their JSON representation? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A row is stored with priority "critical". What happens on GET /tickets/:id?
choices: 500, because fromRow throws on unknown priorities

questions.prompt: A PATCH body contains {"addTags": ["Billing", "billing"]} on a ticket with no tags. What tags does the stored row end up with?
Why does applyPatch build next with new Set(ticket.tags) and new Map(ticket.customFields) instead of relying on the spread alone?
choices: Spread converts Set and Map into plain arrays
Spread copies references, so mutating next.tags would also mutate the original ticket's collections
Spread throws on Set and Map
It is needed so JSON.stringify can serialize them
